headline.text: L3 ML4 TG4 wrapper was down *9 hours* on chain sensor failure — cleared 08:14 when Nelson replaced sensor B1.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran through an internet outage and a 9-hour steamer valve repair on S3. S3 steam valve was installed backwards, causing pressure and temp issues — maintenance corrected it and cooking started 10:37. S1 had three quick stops (rollers, MD bin, depositor freeze) all cleared inside 15 minutes.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 ML2 fought film tears on the wrapper through 3rd shift — sensor, film lot, and tension adjustments brought it back by 00:12. FFS ran pouch centering tweaks and a 30-minute scale calibration mid-morning. Batch/expiration print still not legible as of 06:14.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ML4 lost TG4 for 9 hours overnight when the chain sensor failed and bars jammed the infeed — Nelson swapped sensor B1 at 08:14 and all wrappers running by 09:16. Truffle had a 1-hour Cavanna seal jam cleared by sensor adjust. ML1 C6 belt drifted north repeatedly through 1st shift due to jams.

notes.text: Internet firewall died at 14:30, new firewall live 18:08 — labels caught up by 20:14.
Internet firewall died at 14:30, new firewall live 18:08 — labels caught up by 20:14.
Internet firewall died at 14:30, new firewall live 18:08 — labels caught up by 20:05.
Hansel created a new Sollich 1 enrober shutdown checklist covering PTL tank and Sweco filter cleaning.
Benjamin flagged three LOTO keys without locks and one lock without a key during audit — counterparts being searched.

resolved.title: S3 steamer valve failure blocking cook start
resolved.summary: Steam valve seal blew and check valves were installed backwards, preventing drainage and causing pressure/temp errors — cooking delayed 9 hours.
resolved.resolution: Nathan and crew reseated steam line, corrected backward check valves, and finished repairs by 10:37 — "Maintenance is finished with the steam valves. We are going to start cooking."

resolved.title: S1 tunnel 1 rollers installed over belt instead of under
resolved.summary: Belt was running on top of rollers instead of underneath, risking tracking and product damage.
resolved.resolution: Corrected by 12:17 — Justin: "Rollers have been installed correctly. We have started depositing."

resolved.title: S1 caramel depositor freezing mid-run
resolved.summary: Depositor control panel froze, stopping deposition and risking temper loss.
resolved.resolution: Caleb and Dakota reset via Sollich panel at 19:26 — temper and chiller held, ~5 min downtime.

resolved.title: Grease trap access blocked by pallets
resolved.summary: Pumpers Plus arrived to service grease trap but couldn't access lid due to pallet storage on top.
resolved.resolution: Justin and warehouse moved pallets by 13:16 — Katya: "I am sending WH there now."

resolved.title: S1 MD bin full, belt activations spiking
resolved.summary: Metal detector bin filled with rejects; belt speed too slow to clear product, risking overflow.
resolved.resolution: Emptied bin, Caleb increased blue belt speed 45→50 at 16:59; QA re-ran rejects with no FM detected.

resolved.title: S3 drain clogged with paper towels and caps
resolved.summary: Kitchen operator draining reserve found drain overflowing with trash — paper towels and mild caps wadded in pipe.
resolved.resolution: Cleared immediately at 07:47 — Katya: "We cleared the drain."

resolved.title: S1 cereal and marshmallows stuck at tunnel 2 exit
resolved.summary: One mold section overloaded with cereal/marshmallow got wedged in tunnel door, jamming exit.
resolved.resolution: Cleared and cleaned by 10:07 — Victor: "it got stuck in one of the doors, causing the problem—but it's been resolved now."

resolved.title: FFS plastic foreign material in product zone
resolved.summary: Plastic piece found in line; source traced to leftover part sitting above machine from prior run.
resolved.resolution: Brandon and Raymond identified source, removed all pieces, and pulled affected pouches by 21:03 — "all the parts account for."

resolved.title: FFS blade loose during CIL
resolved.summary: Two bolts tight but blade assembly loose; wrong bolt pattern used, risking blade detachment into product.
resolved.resolution: Fernando replaced with correct bolts and re-torqued by 01:12 — "Blade is tight we need to make sure we are using the correct bolt pattern always."

resolved.title: ML2 flow-wrapper film tearing on both sides
resolved.summary: Film tore repeatedly on startup, blamed on sensor PG15, bobin grab, and tension — 4 rolls wasted from 2nd shift, 4 from 3rd.
resolved.resolution: Adjusted PG15 sensor, drive roller height, bobins, and dancing arm tension; switched to new film lot; line running 00:12 per Zack.

resolved.title: FFS pouch front/back centering off
resolved.summary: Hole punch and graphics misaligned on new 3oz ZS SKU — front appeared right of center, back showed white edge.
resolved.resolution: Operators re-centered through 21:28–21:56; Marlenis posted improved images. Aubrey: "I think the progress this evening was really substantial."

resolved.title: ML2 demolder roller buildup and vacuum clog
resolved.summary: Extensive chocolate buildup on demolder roller and clogged vacuum found during morning CIL — may have contributed to 3rd shift FW issues.
resolved.resolution: Cleaned during extended CIL at 06:50 — Alex will post update after running.

resolved.title: ML4 TG4 chain sensor failure jamming wrapper infeed
resolved.summary: Chain sensor B1 failed, causing bars to sit high and jam the machine — TG4 down from 22:40 until Nelson replaced the sensor at 08:14.
resolved.resolution: Nelson replaced sensor B1 at 08:14 — "Replaced sensor b1 on tg4 it is now running." All TGs confirmed running 09:16.

resolved.title: Truffle Cavanna 1 cutter not sealing or cutting
resolved.summary: Cavanna 1 stopped sealing flow wrap and cutting bites, forcing single-cavanna run and 30 bins of accumulation.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance adjusted jaw and reseated sensor at 03:13 — Raoul: "Sensor wasn't reading properly and they adjusted the jaw." Line restarted 04:10.

resolved.title: Truffle bottomer screw drive error on changeover
resolved.summary: Error code halted changeover to 21175 CPK Dark, delaying deposit start.
resolved.resolution: Error cleared 00:25 — "Bottomer screw drive error code has been fixed, and change over has resumed process."

resolved.title: Truffle guillotine stopped mid-deposit
resolved.summary: Guillotine tested fine before start but stopped cutting when chocolate hit the line.
resolved.resolution: Raoul confirmed working 01:59 — "The Guillotine is working… Product going through the guillotine."

resolved.title: ML4 WDS pre-heating 2 hitting and making noise
resolved.summary: Pre-heater 2 scraping or knocking, traced to chocolate accumulation pushing components up.
resolved.resolution: Kimberly cleared chocolate accumulation at 06:34 — "chocolate accumulation caused it to push up."

resolved.title: ML4 sticker applicator jam causing packaging backup
resolved.summary: Sticker applicator jammed, accumulating product on packaging area and forcing 15-minute line pause.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance cleared jam, line resumed 11:17 after running accumulation through.

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 2 water drain clogged
resolved.summary: Right-side water drain for depositor 2 stopped flowing, risking overflow during CIL.

needs_attention.title: S3 wrong jars and lids staged, correct lids not in building
needs_attention.summary: Line lead discovered staged jars and lids didn't match spec at all — no correct lids on-site, waiting for inbound trailer.
needs_attention.status: Warehouse couldn't locate trailer as of 08:22 despite task ID and trailer number provided by Ricardo. No confirmation of receipt by window close.

needs_attention.title: Foot bath at shipping/receiving entrance not working
needs_attention.summary: Foot sanitizer station offline, creating GMP compliance gap at high-traffic entry point.
needs_attention.status: Reported 15:53, no maintenance response or fix posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: FFS batch and expiration date print not legible
needs_attention.summary: Ink or coder issue rendering batch number and best-by unreadable on pouches — quality hold risk.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 06:14 to adjust coder and improve visibility; no follow-up posted confirming legibility by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML1 C6 belt drifting north on jam cycles
needs_attention.summary: C6 belt repeatedly walked north through 1st shift — posted 11:44, 12:17, 12:43 — confirmed by Nathan at 13:10 as jam-related.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance in line multiple times; blowoff confirmed working; jams causing belt walk as of 13:40, no final fix posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML1 dolly lift wire worn with metal strands exposed
needs_attention.summary: Wire on dolly lift showing wear, creaking under load, with metal strands sticking out — safety and equipment risk.
needs_attention.status: Jenny flagged at 20:41 with photos of frayed wire; Marcos acknowledged; no work order or replacement confirmation by window close.

needs_attention.title: Truffle tunnel 3 scraper tray missing from station
needs_attention.summary: Scraper tray not in place under tunnel 3 — risk of chocolate drip on floor or into next zone.
needs_attention.status: Flagged 00:32, no update on location or replacement by window close.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Cavanna 2 vacuum hose cover missing
needs_attention.summary: Action item to locate missing cover for Cavanna 2 vacuum hose — Grey and line lead searched, couldn't find it.
needs_attention.status: Searched line and surrounding area at 11:03, unable to locate as of window close.

needs_attention.title: Pallets blocking fire extinguisher
needs_attention.summary: Pallets staged in front of fire extinguisher, blocking emergency access.
needs_attention.status: Benjamin asked German to move them at 11:21; no confirmation of clearance by window close.
